# `swift` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### swift.status

Swift toolchain. read-only, idempotent.

Report the Swift compiler, installed cross-compilation SDKs and Android NDK.

No arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.status
```

### swift.android_configure

Connect Swift to the Android NDK. writes, idempotent.

Run the installed Swift SDK's NDK setup script using the configured ANDROID_NDK_HOME. Required after SDK/NDK installation or relocation.

- `sdk` string (default ""): Installed Swift Android SDK identifier

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.android_configure
```

### swift.sdk_install

Install Swift SDK. writes, idempotent.

Install a Swift SDK from a local bundle or HTTPS URL with an explicit SHA-256 checksum.

- `source` string, required: Local artifactbundle path or HTTPS download URL
- `checksum` string (default ""): SHA-256; required for remote downloads

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.sdk_install '{"source":"<source>"}'
```

### swift.plan

Plan Swift build. read-only, idempotent.

Resolve a native SwiftPM build for Android or Linux. Portable unit tests execute on Linux.

- `path` string, required (non-empty): Absolute local filesystem path
- `platform` string (one of android, linux; default "android")
- `architecture` string (one of aarch64, x86_64, armv7; default "aarch64")
- `configuration` string (one of debug, release; default "debug")
- `action` string (one of build, test; default "build")
- `sdk` string (default ""): Installed Swift SDK identifier; defaults to configured Android SDK
- `api_level` integer (23 to 37; default 26)

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.plan '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### swift.execute

Compile / test Swift. writes.

Compile a Swift package to native code or run its Linux unit tests as a job.

- `path` string, required (non-empty): Absolute local filesystem path
- `platform` string (one of android, linux; default "android")
- `architecture` string (one of aarch64, x86_64, armv7; default "aarch64")
- `configuration` string (one of debug, release; default "debug")
- `action` string (one of build, test; default "build")
- `sdk` string (default ""): Installed Swift SDK identifier; defaults to configured Android SDK
- `api_level` integer (23 to 37; default 26)

```sh
tomaccoctl call swift.execute '{"path":"<path>"}'
```
